title: Bhikkhu
text: 2 Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Katamā nu kho bhante vedanā katamo vedanāsamudayo katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā || katamo vedanā-nirodho katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā || ko vedanāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇanti || || [page 233] XXXVI. 24. 7] AṬṬHASATAPARIYĀYA-VAGGO TATIYO 233 4 Tisso imā bhikkhu vedanā || sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā || imā vuccanti bhikkhu tisso vedanā || || Phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo || taṇhā vedanāsamudayagaminī paṭipadā || phassanirodhā vedanānirodho || ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā seyyathīdaṃ sammādiṭṭhi || pe || sammāsamādhi || Yaṃ vedanam paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassam ayaṃ vedanāya assādo || yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā ayam vedanāya ādīnavo || yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānam idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇanti || ||
